name: Awaken: Hentai Dice - The Crimes of Passion
summary: Awaken: The Crimes of Passion is a new chapter of the story. Crime is rampant in the City, and the Magistrates, as usual, can't cope. Restore order, protect the innocent and give in to your passions in this dangerous adventure!
